purpose: Canonical task classes and live guard thresholds for compute resource admission. Observed from cynic-workload ResourceBudget, cynic-inference HardwareProfile, and infra/inference-profiles.json resource_caps.
live_guard_description: Minimum free RAM floor for task admission. Derived from the minimum per-task-class live_guard across all task classes (embedding_bulk and embedding_probe both require 1 GB free).

task_classes.description: Full Rust workspace build (cargo build). High RAM for rustc/cargo, large disk for target/ artifacts.
task_classes.observed_source: cynic-workload ResourceBudget.memory_bytes (8 GB test baseline), cynic-build RUST_MIN_STACK=536870912 (512 MB stack)

task_classes.description: Light Rust check (cargo check). Lower RAM than full build, moderate disk for check artifacts.
Bulk embedding computation (large corpus vectorization). Moderate RAM for embedding model, disk for vector cache.
Single embedding probe (health check / smoke test). Minimal RAM, small disk for single vector.
task_classes.observed_source: cynic-inference embedding_live test, infra/inference-profiles.json resource_caps.memory_max (1G-4G range)

cynic_inference.test_baseline: 32 GB total, 24 GB available, 16 CPU threads
